# 2 Baruch Chapter 17 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** First Fast and Vision

---

**1** I answered: "Lord, you have just told us how short the past age is and how long the coming age will be.

**2** You have shown us that this present age is brief and full of pain, but the future age is long and something to look forward to.

**3** What have we gained from any of this, if we came into the world in agony and live our whole lives in sorrow?

**4** You have shown us that the enemy has been ruling over us. But Adam was the first to sin, and he brought death on all who came after him."

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic rendering. "Something to look forward to" for "desirable" — makes the eschatological hope concrete. "Enemy" for "adversary" — more immediate. "All who came after him" for "all those who were not of his time" — clearer.*
